# The Skill Mill Books
> Nonfiction ebooks for practical skills: cooking, fitness, pet care, home & lifestyle, crafts

## Books
- [The Gluten-Free Ooni Pizza Oven Cookbook](https://theskillmillbooks.com/gluten-free-ooni-pizza/): Gluten-free pizza recipes optimized for Ooni ovens, with tested flour blends and celiac-safe protocols.
- [The Complete Cockatiel Care Handbook](https://theskillmillbooks.com/cockatiel-care/): Everything about cockatiel care — choosing your first bird, training, diet, and health management.
- [Container Gardening for Small Spaces](https://theskillmillbooks.com/container-gardening/): Grow herbs, vegetables, and flowers in containers — perfect for balconies, patios, and small urban spaces.
- [Soy Candle Making for Beginners](https://theskillmillbooks.com/soy-candle-making/): 35+ soy candle projects from beginner to advanced — wicks, fragrance blending, and professional techniques.
- [Digital Declutter for Beginners](https://theskillmillbooks.com/digital-declutter/): Organize files, reduce screen time, manage notifications, and create healthy tech habits.
- [Home Assistant Smart Home for Beginners](https://theskillmillbooks.com/home-assistant-smart-home/): Set up a smart home with Home Assistant — no coding required. Lights, sensors, cameras, and automations.
- [Van Life for Beginners](https://theskillmillbooks.com/van-life/): Complete guide to van life — choosing, converting, budgeting, working remotely, and living on the road.
- [Zone 2 Training for Beginners](https://theskillmillbooks.com/zone-2-training/): Science-backed zone 2 heart rate training for endurance, fat burning, and longevity.
- [Rucking for Beginners](https://theskillmillbooks.com/rucking/): Complete guide to rucking — walking with a weighted pack for strength, calorie burn, and cardio.
- [Cold Plunge Therapy for Beginners](https://theskillmillbooks.com/cold-plunge-therapy/): Practical guide to cold exposure for recovery, mental clarity, and immune health.
- [Budgerigar Care for Beginners](https://theskillmillbooks.com/budgerigar-care/): Essential guide to budgerigar (parakeet) care — habitat, diet, training, health, and bonding.
- [The Honest AI Side Hustle Guide](https://theskillmillbooks.com/ai-side-hustles/): 7 proven AI side hustles with verified income ranges, real startup costs, and week-by-week plans.
- [Leash Training for Reactive Dogs](https://theskillmillbooks.com/leash-training-reactive-dogs/): Step-by-step force-free plan for dogs that bark and lunge on leash — trigger distance, counterconditioning, the LAT game, BAT basics, and an 8-week plan.
